Synthetic playback fixtures, generated for Coffee:

- `animated.webp`: two 70×70 solid-color frames (orange and sienna), 200 ms per frame, looping. Made with ImageMagick.
- `grid.heic`: a 128×96 solid-color background with a darker rectangle, encoded as a 2×2 HEVC tile grid using `heif-enc --cut-tiles 64`.
